definitions.explanation: At a fast pace, with urgency.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: It's dangerous if you run suddenly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急|きゅう}に⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I suddenly got a fever and stayed home from school.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}わらせた→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{急|きゅう}に⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Since there was no time, I ate quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れ→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧⟦そうだった→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{急|きゅう}に⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Since I was about to miss the train, I left home quickly.

notes:
{急|きゅう}に is an adverb formed from the na-adjective ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (sudden, urgent).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {急|きゅう}に⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (to stop suddenly)
- {急|きゅう}に⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (to change suddenly)
- {急|きゅう}に⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (to start suddenly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急|きゅう}に vs. ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: Both mean "suddenly," but ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ emphasizes unexpectedness more strongly, while {急|きゅう}に can also mean "quickly/hurriedly."
- {急|きゅう}に vs. ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧: ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧ implies doing something without warning or preamble, often with a nuance of rudeness.

NOTE: {急|きゅう}に can describe both unexpected events and urgent/hurried actions.
